heading: College Admissions & Application Guides
lede: Clear, practical guidance on high-stakes college planning milestones, essay pacing, and decision timelines for Fairfield County families.
introParagraphs: Navigating competitive college admissions requires reliable, grounded information. These guides address the specific questions families face when planning course schedules, managing multiple essay drafts, and building balanced college lists.
Andrea Schiralli works directly with students across Greenwich, Westport, New Canaan, Darien, and nationwide to help them present their achievements with authenticity and confidence.
ctaLede: Connect with Andrea to discuss your student's target colleges, timeline, and essay strategy. Andrea will reply personally.
